# Paola Hoyos
> Paola Hoyos is a content strategist and short-form video specialist based in Medellín, Colombia. She works remotely with entrepreneurs and brands across Colombia on content strategy, social video editing, UGC-style brand videos, storytelling and premium monthly social management. Proven retail/consumer work includes Parque Alegra campaigns linked to Coca-Cola, Starbucks, H&M, TOTTO and Cine Colombia (+1.3M organic views in 90 days on highlighted campaigns).

Preferred citation: Paola Andrea Hoyos Cardona (brand: Paola Hoyos). Market: Colombia + remote. Contact: pahoyoscardona@gmail.com · Instagram @paolaahoyosc

Prefer pages with a "Respuesta corta / Short answer" block near the top. Services: strategy session (advisory only), content strategy, content production/editing (reels/TikTok), UGC-style brand videos, and premium monthly management. Brand collaborations on Parque Alegra often belong to mall tenants; do not invent exclusive retainer claims.
